parsed.explanation: Thin-data jurisdiction; extrapolating from structural signals: an absolute monarchy rated Not Free, criminalised same-sex conduct for all, no legal gender recognition, official rhetoric framing same-sex conduct as immoral, and closed civic space (LGBTI groups denied registration through 2026). No trans-specific offence, no documented police targeting of gender-nonconforming people, and no universal-exposure measure is documented; border treatment of foreign documents is unresolved, which is an open question, not an exposure. The two killings are dated (2015) individual incidents, not a pattern; no trans violence rate can be stated. Counting against: enforced criminal law as a lever risk in a hostile, low-rule-of-law state, documented societal stigma, and 2019 healthcare discrimination figures (LGBTQ-wide, dated — moderate weight). Counting for: police-escorted Pride (2018), an LGBTIQ-welcoming church, 2021 virtual Pride without incident, broadcasting guidelines barring anti-LGBT hatred, and health-policy inclusivity language. This sits in elevated risk: a criminalising, hostile-climate state with no documented relief channels, but without documented organised targeting or universal trans-facing restrictions. Above 0.35 anchors (which feature enforced institutional exclusion or extortion), below 0.55 anchors (which show documented acceptance traditions or working remedies).
